instructions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write your own address.

prompts.prompt: You recently bought a piece of furniture online, but it arrived damaged. Write a letter to the company. In your letter: describe the item you purchased, explain what is wrong with it, and say what action you would like the company to take.

You are currently taking an evening class, but you will not be able to attend the final two sessions due to a work commitment. Write a letter to your teacher. In your letter: explain your situation, ask what you will miss, and suggest how you might make up the missed work.

A friend of yours is planning to move to your city for a new job. Write a letter to your friend. In your letter: give some advice about finding accommodation, tell them what to expect about the cost of living, and offer to help them settle in.

You recently stayed at a hotel for a family vacation, and the service did not meet your expectations. Write a letter to the hotel manager. In your letter: explain when you stayed and why, describe the problems you experienced, and say what you would like the manager to do.

You ordered a new laptop online, but it arrived with a broken screen. Write a letter to the retailer. In your letter: describe the laptop model you bought, explain the damage, and state what you would like the retailer to do about it.

You are hosting a gathering at your home and would like to invite some friends. Write a letter to your friends. In your letter: mention the date and time of the gathering, describe what activities you have planned, and say what they should bring.

You recently had a job interview, and you want to thank the interviewer. Write a letter to them. In your letter: express your gratitude for the opportunity, mention something specific from the interview that you enjoyed, and reiterate your interest in the position.

You want to apply for a volunteer position at a local charity. Write a letter to the charity organization. In your letter: introduce yourself, explain why you want to volunteer, and outline any relevant skills or experience you have.

You are moving to a new apartment and need to inform your landlord about your change of address. Write a letter to your landlord. In your letter: state your current address, provide your new address, and mention when you will be moving out.

You ordered a dinner set online, but some pieces were missing when it arrived. Write a letter to the company. In your letter: describe the dinner set you bought, explain what was missing, and say how you would like the company to rectify the situation.

You would like to apply for a job that has been advertised in your local newspaper. Write a letter to the employer. In your letter: mention which job you are applying for, outline your qualifications and experience, and explain why you would be a good fit for the position.
You received a gift package from a friend. Write a letter to thank them. In your letter: mention what the package contained, express your feelings about the gift, and suggest a plan to meet soon.

You are hosting a birthday party and would like to invite a close friend. Write a letter to your friend. In your letter: state the time and location of the party, explain what activities you have planned, and let them know if they can bring a guest.

You have noticed that your internet connection is not working properly. Write a letter to your internet service provider. In your letter: explain the problem you are experiencing, provide any relevant account information, and request a technician to fix the issue.

You recently stayed at a hotel, but faced several issues during your visit. Write a letter to the hotel manager. In your letter: explain the problems you encountered, describe how they affected your stay, and suggest how the hotel could improve in the future.

You are planning a small gathering at your house and would like to invite a friend. Write a letter to your friend. In your letter: explain the purpose of the gathering, provide details about the time and date, and mention what they should bring.

You are applying for a job that was recently advertised. Write a letter to the employer. In your letter: introduce yourself, outline your qualifications and experience, and explain why you are interested in the position.
You recently received a gift from a relative. Write a letter to thank them. In your letter: mention what the gift was, explain how you plan to use it, and express your feelings about their gesture.

You recently attended a workshop and would like to provide feedback to the organization. Write a letter to the workshop organizer. In your letter: describe your experience, mention what you liked and what could be improved, and suggest any additional topics you think should be covered in future workshops.

You recently booked a flight but had to cancel it due to unforeseen circumstances. Write a letter to the airline. In your letter: explain your situation, outline the issues with their cancellation policy, and request a refund or credit for future travel.

You are interested in applying for a job at a local company but need more information. Write a letter to the HR department. In your letter: state the job you are interested in, ask about the application process, and inquire about the qualifications required.

You are hosting a birthday party at your home and want to invite a friend. Write a letter to your friend. In your letter: mention the date and time of the party, describe what activities you have planned, and say why you would like them to come.

You are going away on vacation and need a favor from your neighbor. Write a letter to your neighbor. In your letter: explain your situation, specify the favor you need, and mention how long you will be away.

A colleague helped you with a project, and you want to express your gratitude. Write a letter to your colleague. In your letter: thank them for their assistance, mention how their help made a difference, and propose to take them out for coffee as a gesture of appreciation.

You are planning a birthday party for a friend and need some help. Write a letter to a close friend. In your letter: explain what the party is about, specify the help you need, and mention the date of the party.
You have decided to resign from your job. Write a letter to your employer. In your letter: state your intention to resign, explain your reasons briefly, and mention your last working day.
You are inviting a colleague to your wedding. Write a letter to your colleague. In your letter: provide details about the wedding, explain why you want them to come, and ask them to RSVP.
